finalText:
**Drafted 4.2.0 into `CHANGELOG.md`.** Out of 380 commits, 14 matter.

Two of them are breaking but weren't labelled that way:
- An expired token now returns `401`, not `403`.
- The latency histogram units changed. Old dashboards will read wrong.

Also breaking: the `v1` export route is gone. Internal error types stopped being re-exported.

One new thing: webhook deliveries now retry with backoff. Nine real fixes, including one that stopped request bodies landing in logs.

I left out speed-only work, since nothing about behaviour changed. Five commits say "note the minimum node version" but only touch docs. Worth checking whether the real floor moved.
